KCMSC is housed in a magnificent ten-storied building accommodating students ranging from Play Group to Grade Twelve. It offers both Bangla and English Versions of National curricula of education. KCMSC started its auspicious journey on 1st January 2015 with 2200 students.

The mission of KCMSC is to enable students to explore their full potential physically, mentally, and spiritually to make them responsible global citizens.

Brig Gen Mushfiqur Rahman SPP, psc (retd) was involved with this institution as its Chief Advisor from its very outset. In addition, very

efficient and experienced educationists were appointed as principals and Vice Principals to build up a strong senior management team. The teachers are selected on the basis of merit and competence through a transparent and fair recruiting process.

The classroom ambiance, student-teacher interaction, and teaching methods are all carefully designed for students to develop a lifelong desire to learn. Our digitally equipped and spacious classrooms enable students to be more than spectators. They are encouraged to actively participate in class activities. Each of the classrooms is neatly designed to accommodate about 30 students. In addition, there are three large digital classrooms equipped with multi-media projectors and smart boards to facilitate PowerPoint presentations.

The Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and ICT labs are well-equipped and well-utilized for practical-oriented learning. Since its inception, the institution has striven to maintain a measured but steady pace of growth in the number of students. K C Model School and College (KCMSC) is a renowned educational institution near Uttara, at 275, Prembagan, Dakshinkhan, Dhaka-1230. It was founded in 2014 by a leading industrialist of Bangladesh, Al-Hajj Md. Khashru Chowdhury (CIP), founder of Nipa Group. He dreamt of making it an ideal institution that would produce citizens capable of meeting the challenges of the 21st century.

KCMSC is housed in a magnificent ten-storied building accommodating students ranging from Play Group to Grade Twelve. It offers both Bangla and English Versions of National curricula of education. KCMSC started its auspicious journey on 1st January 2015 with 2200 students.

The mission of KCMSC is to enable students to explore their full potential physically, mentally, and spiritually to make them responsible global citizens.

Brig Gen Mushfiqur Rahman SPP, psc (retd) was involved with this institution as its Chief Advisor from its very outset. In addition, very

efficient and experienced educationists were appointed as principals and Vice Principals to build up a strong senior management team. The teachers are selected on the basis of merit and competence through a transparent and fair recruiting process.

The classroom ambiance, student-teacher interaction, and teaching methods are all carefully designed for students to develop a lifelong desire to learn. Our digitally equipped and spacious classrooms enable students to be more than spectators. They are encouraged to actively participate in class activities. Each of the classrooms is neatly designed to accommodate about 30 students. In addition, there are three large digital classrooms equipped with multi-media projectors and smart boards to facilitate PowerPoint presentations.

The Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and ICT labs are well-equipped and well-utilized for practical-oriented learning. We focus not only on grades and results but also on the critical and analytical thinking capability of the students. The institution has a rich Library and all students have a weekly Library Class. The aim is to inculcate broad-based reading habits in our students.

Since its inception, the institution has striven to maintain a measured but steady pace of growth in the number of students. This policy has, so far, paid rich dividends in terms of institutional development. We are now confident that this conservative rate of growth has enabled us to assess, reflect upon and design our future course, thus avoiding the risks of unplanned hasty expansion.

It has also resulted in a comprehensive, systematic, and structured evolution of such school facilities as Wi-Fi to cope with the requirement of online classes during the Covid-19 pandemic. It can safely and proudly be said that it is one of the very few educational institutions which had effectively and regularly conducted online classes during the pandemic. The adoption of a gradual but carefully defined expansion policy has helped KCMSC to build a healthy relationship among its workforce, its student body, and the guardians at large.
Today, KCMSC looks forward to a future of constant and uninterrupted growth and hopes to set an example of an institution that is able to endure the test of trying times in the coming years. We firmly believe that to create a prosperous nation, there is no alternative to building a generation of well-educated citizens who will lead the nation forward.

WELCOME TO K C MODEL SCHOOL & COLLEGE
K C Model School and College (KCMSC) is a renowned educational institution near Uttara, at 275, Prembagan, Dakshinkhan, Dhaka-1230. It was founded in 2014 by a leading industrialist of Bangladesh, Al-Hajj Md. Khashru Chowdhury (CIP), founder of Nipa Group. He dreamt of making it an ideal institution that would produce citizens capable of meeting the challenges of the 21st century.

KCMSC is housed in a magnificent ten-storied building accommodating students ranging from Play Group to Grade Twelve. It offers both Bangla and English Versions of National curricula of education. KCMSC started its auspicious journey on 1st January 2015 with 2200 students.

The mission of KCMSC is to enable students to explore their full potential physically, mentally, and spiritually to make them responsible global citizens.

Brig Gen Mushfiqur Rahman SPP, psc (retd) was involved with this institution as its Chief Advisor from its very outset. In addition, very

efficient and experienced educationists were appointed as principals and Vice Principals to build up a strong senior management team. The teachers are selected on the basis of merit and competence through a transparent and fair recruiting process.

The classroom ambiance, student-teacher interaction, and teaching methods are all carefully designed for students to develop a lifelong desire to learn. Our digitally equipped and spacious classrooms enable students to be more than spectators. They are encouraged to actively participate in class activities. Each of the classrooms is neatly designed to accommodate about 30 students. In addition, there are three large digital classrooms equipped with multi-media projectors and smart boards to facilitate PowerPoint presentations.

The Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and ICT labs are well-equipped and well-utilized for practical-oriented learning. We focus not only on grades and results but also on the critical and analytical thinking capability of the students. The institution has a rich Library and all students have a weekly Library Class. The aim is to inculcate broad-based reading habits in our students.

Since its inception, the institution has striven to maintain a measured but steady pace of growth in the number of students. This policy has, so far, paid rich dividends in terms of institutional development. We are now confident that this conservative rate of growth has enabled us to assess, reflect upon and design our future course, thus avoiding the risks of unplanned hasty expansion.

It has also resulted in a comprehensive, systematic, and structured evolution of such school facilities as Wi-Fi to cope with the requirement of online classes during the Covid-19 pandemic. It can safely and proudly be said that it is one of the very few educational institutions which had effectively and regularly conducted online classes during the pandemic. The adoption of a gradual but carefully defined expansion policy has helped KCMSC to build a healthy relationship among its workforce, its student body, and the guardians at large.
Today, KCMSC looks forward to a future of constant and uninterrupted growth and hopes to set an example of an institution that is able to endure the test of trying times in the coming years. We firmly believe that to create a prosperous nation, there is no alternative to building a generation of well-educated citizens who will lead the nation forward.
